inlines.v: EXPOUND', verb transitive [Latin expono; ex and pono, to set.] 1. To explain; to lay open the meaning; to clear of obscurity; to interpret; as, to expound a text of scripture; to expound a law. 2. To lay open; to examine; as, to expound the pocket. [Not used.]
